description: Sort the entries of array in place, ordered by compareFn, and return the same array, as in ECMAScript. The sort is stable: entries that compare equal keep their order. The array may hold any mix of data types, as compareFn decides the order. A frozen array is an error before compareFn is called. Use to_sorted for a sorted copy.

parameters.description: The array to sort. Must not be frozen.
parameters.name: array

parameters.description: Called with two entries, once per comparison. Return true, or a negative integer, when a sorts before b; false, zero or a positive integer otherwise. Entries that compare equal keep their order. Any other result, a double included, is an error.
parameters.name: compareFn

sideEffects: The array is sorted in place.
